critical_code_review_comments: Kinetic.jsx Reveal component previously dropped extra props (data-testid) — fixed by spreading `...rest` onto motion.div so any test-id/aria attributes flow through. This was blocking the required 'governance-privacy-card' testid from appearing in DOM.

About.jsx only applied data-testid='governance-privacy-card' to the second card (Privacy by Policy). Per spec both cards ('Governance by Charter' + 'Privacy by Policy') share the testid — added it to the first Reveal too so a single query returns exactly 2 cards.

index.html sets a static <title> but per-route titles (e.g., 'Market Intelligence — OKI Inc.' on /markets) override it via react-helmet or similar. Root '/' correctly shows 'OKI Inc. — International Holdings & Investments'.
Preloader is session-scoped (sessionStorage 'oki-entered'). Automated agents must seed this key before first navigation to avoid flaky selector waits.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is the final polish pass and it is CLEAN. Privacy scan (no CoinGecko/Yahoo/officer titles) verified on all 7 routes via document.body.textContent. FAQ lives on Home only (5 items, testid pattern faq-toggle-N — NOT faq-item-N). Governance card testid now present twice on /about after Kinetic.Reveal fix. rca of the issue: Two small testability defects were found and fixed here: (1) Kinetic.Reveal did not spread its remaining props, so `data-testid='governance-privacy-card'` was silently dropped by React — fixed by adding `...rest` to the component signature and spreading onto the underlying motion.div. (2) About.jsx only applied that testid to one of the two governance cards; added it to the first card so the query returns 2 as spec'd. No other regressions found in this pass.
